fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.article-content-area since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-sitemap, Google News sitemap at /sitemaps/news.xml) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-sitemap).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

articleId.title: Article ID
articleId.description: Internal numeric GhanaWeb article ID, taken from the trailing digits of the article URL.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the NewsArticle ld+json node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article summary, from the NewsArticle ld+json node.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, reconstructed from
-separated lines inside div.article-content-area, truncated before the trailing reporter-initials signature line and any promo/related-video content that follows it (see CRAWLING_METHOD.md).

reporterInitials.title: Reporter initials
reporterInitials.description: GhanaWeb's internal 2-part reporter/editor-initials signature (e.g. "MRA/MA"), found as a standalone line at the end of the real article body on staff-written pieces. Null on Opinions/Features pieces, which don't carry this signature.

author.title: Author
author.description: Name from the ld+json author object -- "GhanaWeb" (a NewsMediaOrganization, no individual byline) on staff-written News/Sports/Business/Entertainment pieces; null on Opinions/Features pieces.

bylineLabel.title: Byline label
bylineLabel.description:
Label of the

byline block on the page: "Source" on staff pieces, "Columnist" on opinion pieces.

bylineName.title: Byline name
bylineName.description: Value of the byline block: "www.ghanaweb.com" on staff pieces, or the individual columnist's name on opinion pieces (the only place an individual author's name appears).

category.title: Category
category.description: Section name from the ld+json NewsArticle node's articleSection field, e.g. "News", "Opinions".

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead thumbnail image URL from ld+json.

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image object (url/caption/width/height) from ld+json, passed through as-is.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode sitemap item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the sitemap item.

section.title: Section
section.description: URL path segment right after /GhanaHomePage/ (e.g. NewsArchive, SportsArchive, business, entertainment) -- latest mode only, since the sitemap carries no explicit category field.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: ISO 8601 publish date from the news:publication_date sitemap field -- latest mode only.

language.title: Language
language.description: ISO language code from the news:language sitemap field -- latest mode only.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
